name: connecthub-monorepo
description: ConnectHub - Full-Stack Professional Networking Platform Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
